Nathan — thanks for the matrix and the clear asks. Looping in Marissa (Legal) and Lauren (Sales Ops) to confirm exact language. My quick notes below — were generally aligned with your categories but with some limits/clarifications: 

- Commercial General Liability (CGL): $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate.
- Professional Liability / E&O: $1,000,000 per claim / $1,000,000 aggregate (we can discuss higher limits if your regulator requires).
- Cyber / Privacy Liability: $2,000,000 aggregate (well require evidence of coverage for incidents involving customer data).
- Commercial Auto: $1,000,000 combined single limit (only if vehicle usage is part of the scope).

Additional insured: We can accept limited additional insured status that applies to our indemnity obligations arising out of Redwoods services. We prefer to avoid broad blanket additional insured language that expands liability beyond the indemnity carve-out.

Certificate of Insurance: please have your insurer provide a COI naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." as certificate holder and include endorsements where required. Well attach a COI template and our suggested Order Form redlines.

Marissa — can you confirm the bullet points above and share the exact endorsement wording we should ask for? Lauren — Ill need a PDF of the Order Form with the insurance section redlined so we can return to GreenBank.

Thanks,

Rishi / team — thanks for the context. Below is Legals proposed language wed be comfortable with including in the Order Form / MSA. Ive attached a short COI template (Redwood_COI_Template.pdf) and a marked-up Order Form for your review.

Proposed insurance language (suggest inserting under Section X of the Order Form):
1) Commercial General Liability: Contractor shall maintain Commercial General Liability insurance with limits of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence and $2,000,000 in the aggregate. Redwood Inference, Inc. shall be listed as an additional insured via an endorsement limited to liability arising out of the services provided under this Agreement.
2) Professional Liability / Errors & Omissions: Contractor shall maintain professional liability insurance with limits of not less than $1,000,000 per claim and in the aggregate.
3) Cyber / Privacy Liability: Contractor shall maintain Cyber Liability insurance with limits of not less than $2,000,000 aggregate covering liability for data breach, privacy violations, and network security incidents.
4) Commercial Auto: Where vehicles are used to perform services under this Agreement, Contractor shall maintain auto liability insurance with a combined single limit of not less than $1,000,000.
5) Waiver of Subrogation & Primary Coverage: Where permitted by law, Contractors policies shall be primary and non-contributory with respect to claims covered under this Agreement, and Contractor shall waive subrogation against Redwood.
6) Notice & Certificates: Contractor shall provide Certificate(s) of Insurance evidencing the required coverage and endorsements prior to commencement of services and upon renewal. Certificates should reference the Agreement number and list Redwood Inference, Inc. as the certificate holder.

Endorsements accepted: We prefer the standard ISO additional insured endorsement or a similarly worded endorsement that limits additional insured coverage to liability arising from Contractors work. We do not accept endorsements that expand insured status to Redwoods independent contractors or that create a broad transfer of risk.

Operational notes:
- For cloud/SaaS-only vendors where there is no customer-managed infrastructure or on-site work, we can be flexible on Auto limits and primary/noncontributory wording.
- For regulated financial customers (GreenBank), Legal recommends we ask for Cyber coverage at $2M and E&O at $1M; we will escalate to exec sign-off if they request higher limits.

Attachments: Redwood_COI_Template.pdf (COI + endorsement placeholders), Marked_Order_Form.docx (redlines).

- Lauren: please generate a PDF with the redlined insurance section and attach.
- Karthik: FYI for renewals/process for verifying COIs in our vendor portal.

-Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
